What's included in FlowCV's Free Plan
You won't find a more generous free plan among resume builders.
Here's what you get with FlowCV's free plan.
Your First Resume Is Free Forever
Create, edit, and save one resume for free for life. No trial period. No credit card. No auto-upgrade.
Just You on Your Resume
We never brand your resume. No FlowCV logo and no watermarks. Your resume is your place to shine.
Unlimited PDF Downloads
Update, edit, and download your one free resume as often as you like. There are no download limits.
50+ Customizable Templates

Import Content or Start From Scratch

We Respect Your Privacy

Frequently Asked Questions
What is FlowCV and how does it work?
FlowCV is a free, easy-to-use online resume builder for creating professional, ATS-friendly resumes fast. Choose from 50+ free templates, customize layout and design, and download unlimited, watermark-free PDFs. Start from blank or import an existing resume to prefill content.
Is FlowCV really free?
Yes. Your first resume is free forever with unlimited, watermark-free PDF downloads, access to all templates, and full layout and design control. No paywall, no trial, no credit card required, no hidden fees, and no automatic upgrade. You only pay for extras like saving multiple versions or AI writing assistance.
Why is FlowCV free?
FlowCV is built by a small, independent team focused on delivering a truly free resume builder that helps people worldwide get hired. We fund development through optional paid features like saving multiple versions or AI writing assistance. As a result, our free plan remains generous, with unlimited watermark-free PDFs, full template access, and full design control.
Can I save multiple resume versions on FlowCV?
Yes. One resume is free to edit and download without limits. To save multiple versions at the same time (e.g., for different roles or languages), upgrade to a paid plan. If you switch back to the free plan, only your first resume stays editable and downloadable; additional versions remain saved but locked.
How does FlowCV protect my data?
FlowCV is privacy-first and commited to GDPR-compliance. We don't use third-party tracking cookies or sell your personal data. You own your content and can delete your account and data at any time. For details, see our Privacy Policy [/privacy-policy].
Does FlowCV support multiple languages?
Yes. You can write your resume in multiple languages and customize section labels, date formats, and page size (A4/Letter). FlowCV also supports the RTL (right-to-left) languages Arabic and Hebrew. Many users keep one resume per language; upgrading lets you save and manage multiple versions easily.
Can I also create cover letters with FlowCV?
Yes. You can create a cover letter that matches your resume design. On the free plan, you can save one cover letter and download it without watermarks; saving multiple cover letters or using AI assistance requires an upgrade to a paid plan.
Are FlowCV resumes ATS-friendly?
Yes. FlowCV exports clean, text-based PDFs with embedded fonts and simple structure, so ATS tools can read your resume without issues—even with two-column templates; if you're worried about very old systems, it's safest to pick a one-column layout.
In practice, what matters most is that a human can quickly skim your resume, so focus on clear headings, relevant keywords, and impact-focused bullets.
Can I import an existing resume into FlowCV?
Yes. You can import in three ways: upload a PDF or DOCX, upload an image (PNG/JPG) of your resume, or paste your resume text directly into the builder; in all cases, your content is imported into a clean, ATS-friendly layout with a professional design so you can start faster.
Is FlowCV top-rated by users?
Yes. FlowCV is rated highly on Trustpilot [https://www.trustpilot.com/review/flowcv.com] (4.9/5), Google Reviews [https://www.google.com/maps/place/FlowCV/@48.2202331,16.3796424,47666m/data=!3m2!1e3!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0xa3f534006aabdc3f:0x949c7a14e71ad9f!8m2!3d48.2202331!4d16.3796424!16s%2Fg%2F11l6wk75c9?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDUyMS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D] (4.8/5), and Product Hunt [https://www.producthunt.com/products/flowcv] (4.9/5), and based on our review of publicly available ratings for established online resume builders with a free plan, it is among the highest-rated.*
* Ratings as of Jan 2026.
